short.title: Same Bones, Two Verdicts: The Carthage Tophet Mystery

long.title: Carthage's Tophet: Burial Ground or Place of Sacrifice?
long.description:
In 1921, carved stones were found being dug up by moonlight on the edge of Tunis. Beneath them: urn after urn of cremated infants and young lambs. A century later, two teams of specialists have studied the same remains — and reached conflicting conclusions. Were the children of Carthage's tophet sacrificed, or mourned and buried with care?

This documentary follows the evidence: the excavations, the ancient Greek accusations, the Punic inscriptions, the skeletal science — and what the evidence can and cannot establish. Interpretations are credited to the scholars who hold them; no side is presented as settled.
